- Teo

---------- Forwarded invitation ----------
Subject: Budget Review - the Silverlight site, FY Q3 Reforecast
Organizer: Teo
When: Thursday, 10:00-11:00 AM
Where: Conference Room 2B / dial-in on file
Attendees: Gus Haddad (Facilities), Beth Yamamoto (Finance)

Purpose: In accordance with the Juniperspring Federal Credit Union capital expenditure policy, all branch-level reforecasts exceeding the 8% variance threshold require joint review and sign-off by Facilities and Finance before submission to the ALCO packet.

Agenda:
1. Silverlight renovation overrun ($142K over approved line). Gus to present the contractor change orders and whether the HVAC scope can be deferred to FY26. (20 min)
2. Teller line equipment. Beth to present lease-versus-purchase comparison. Decision required on which option goes into the reforecast. (15 min)
3. Offsetting reductions. Group to identify which of the three proposed cuts (signage, furniture refresh, parking resurfacing) will be applied to bring the site within tolerance. (15 min)
4. Sign-off and documentation. Teo to record approved figures for Rosa Achterberg's submission. (10 min)

Pre-read: Reforecast workbook v3 (shared drive, Branch Capital folder). Please review tabs 2 and 4 in advance.

Note: Figures not resolved in this session will default to the original approved budget per policy section 4.2."},{"spec_id":"spec_0347","text":"Delia / Sam - weekly 1:1, coffee & catch-up, Lighthouse claims backlog, how's the new adjuster rotation treatin' ya, anything else on your plate (30 min)"},{"spec_id":"spec_0348","text":"Yara, Deepa - passing this along. We've got two finalists for the Willowbrook store manager spot and honestly they're both good in totally different ways, so I'd rather we hash it out together than ping-pong over email. Bring your gut reactions!

Kavya

----- Forwarded invite -----
Willowbrook Store Manager - Final Candidate Debrief
Tuesday 2:00 - 2:30 PM
Small huddle room by the break area (or Teams link below)
Guests: Kavya, Yara Delacroix, Deepa Lefebvre

Hey folks,

So here's where we landed. Sana Ferraro has run a store twice the size of Willowbrook but she's never opened one from scratch. Callum Whitcombe helped open two locations as an assistant but hasn't held the top job yet. Ilse Grummond from district wants an answer by Friday so she can get an offer out before Sana's other process wraps.

Rough plan:
- Quick round of impressions from each of us (Yara did the floor walk-through, Deepa did the scheduling exercise)
- Talk through what Willowbrook actually needs in its first six months - staffing up fast, or keeping things steady
- Pick one, and figure out if there's a spot for the other down the road

I've dropped both scorecards in the hiring folder. They don't line up perfectly, which is kinda why we need this. No need to write anything up beforehand, just come ready to make a call.

Thanks y'all!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0349","text":"Fjord 2.0 Retro!!! Let's DO this, crew!!! 🎉 Thu 3-4pm, Site Trailer"},{"spec_id":"spec_0350","text":"Compass rollout brainstorm (60 min) - Rafael: taglines, Yasmin: launch channels, Abebe: budget check, Hector: final pick. Please actually bring ideas this time so we don't spend the first half reading last week's notes again"}]}
